editorial.blurb: Guac Time has mastered the art of the burrito bowl with fresh ingredients, generous portions, and quality halal meat that's earned loyal devotion from diners across Chicago.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the burrito bowl—it's what keeps customers coming back and what they're known for; the portions are massive and the guacamole is a standout highlight.

topDishes.note: Massive portions, fresh ingredients, addictively good—customers won't eat burrito bowls anywhere else
Amazing taste with halal-certified meat, a standout proteins choice
Fresh and excellent, a highlight of the meal
